retrieval_limitations: This is a verified seed set, not a complete directory of Zagreb architectural studios. HKA's full office registers could not be retrieved during this collection; indexed individual-member directory rows were used as evidence where available.
HKA directory entries are person/member records that may show an employer or office address; they are not a comprehensive count of firms. The HKA architect-urbanist register was used for Urbanistica.
Company and address were checked against the studio's own public website, but addresses may change after the observation date. Re-verify before relying on them for official service or contact.

The MPGI PDFs cover legal entities licensed for spatial planning, including institutions; they are not a census of architecture practices. PDF entries without independently verified studio websites remain separate leads. Some older authorization addresses differ from the current official-site address and are recorded separately.
